features.feature: Managed SSH workspace and terminal lifecycle
gaps: No ssh command or typed remote descriptor
Missing -p/--port, -i/--identity, --name, --command/trailing argv, --window, --focus/--no-focus, -A/-a, repeated --ssh-option, TTY, transport and profile options
No ssh_config resolution, route-sensitive connection sharing, host-key/password flow, bootstrap, remote workspace identity or duplicate-session prevention
acceptance: Create a remotely identified workspace/surface through key, password, alias, explicit port/identity and proxy/jump routes
Reject unknown/conflicting/missing options before spawning
Preserve destination, route, working directory, focus choice and remote execution across reconnect without local fallback

features.feature: Mosh terminal and mosh-tmux transport
gaps: No mosh or mosh-tmux command
No local/remote capability probe, address resolution, management bootstrap or explicit SSH fallback
No transport identity persisted for restore/reconnect
acceptance: Use mosh when both endpoints support the required integration
Surface local missing, local unsupported, remote missing, probe failure, bootstrap failure and address fallback distinctly
Fall back to the already validated SSH route without duplicating a workspace

features.feature: Remote tmux list, attach, mirror and window topology
gaps: No ssh-tmux list/attach/mirror/new-window family
Missing session, port, identity, workspace name, focus, new-window, transport port/helper/broker options
No remote tmux window/pane identity, topology mirror, progress, auth retry or stale-stream policy
acceptance: List sessions without creating UI, then attach a selected session with exact window/pane identity
Mirror create/close/rename/reorder/focus/resize/input in both directions
Retry interactive authentication at most once and fail visibly on missing tmux, stale streams or topology conflicts

features.feature: Managed local tmux and zellij lifecycle
gaps: A prototype/local shell can execute arbitrary programs but there is no managed tmux/zellij owner
Missing start, attach, list, status, detach, close, cleanup, detached/headless and app-bound modes
No secure registry/socket validation or stable session binding
acceptance: Manage tmux and zellij sessions through typed lifecycle commands
Work headlessly for supported inspection/cleanup and require the app only for app-bound attachment
Reconcile stale registries without killing unrelated user sessions

features.feature: Persistent remote PTY reconnect, replay and cleanup
gaps: Local PTY close/exit state has no remote daemon/session lifecycle identity
Missing session list/attach/cleanup/end and daemon status
No replay boundary, resize/input owner handoff, lifecycle ID, parked session, lost-session respawn policy or reconnect prompt
acceptance: Reconnect the same remote session after transport loss with bounded replay
Keep resize, input and output ownership singular during retry
Distinguish transient bridge failure, authentication failure, session loss and intentional end without duplicate sessions

features.feature: Authorized remote CLI relay
gaps: The local Unix control socket is not a remote relay
No deny-by-default method allowlist, owned workspace/surface alias map, selector narrowing or command-bearing parameter rejection
No relay authentication, lifecycle, focus policy or remote-host execution proof
acceptance: Authenticate each relay and deny unlisted methods by default
Restrict every ID/ref/array selector to objects owned by the relay session
Reject local command/content execution and local-state exposure; do not allow terminal spawn/respawn until live remote-host execution is proven

features.feature: Remote Mac device registry and attach routes
gaps: No remotes/remote list, add or remove namespace
Cloud sign-in does not provide a team device registry, repeated attach routes, optional tags or idempotent update-by-name
No local and server-side validation limiting routes to Tailscale numeric peers or authenticated *.ts.net MagicDNS peers
acceptance: List sanitized registered devices and routes without changing focus
Require at least one --route for add, reject loopback/LAN/arbitrary hosts, and revalidate at the registry trust boundary
Update idempotently by name and remove by exact name or device ID with explicit not-found and authorization failures

features.feature: Remote file and image drop/upload
gaps: No native terminal file/image drop classifier or remote upload worker
No reuse of the terminal's SSH route/credentials/proxy/jump identity
No preparation deadline, size bound, progress, cancellation, cleanup, partial failure or originating-surface generation binding
acceptance: Upload files, directories allowed by policy, image files and raw clipboard images to the actual remote destination
Verify remote bytes before inserting shell-quoted paths and never insert a local path for a remote target
Cancel and clean up safely across slow transfer, tab switch/close/move, disconnect, permission denial and partial failure

features.feature: Target-bound terminal paste across local and remote sessions
gaps: Native Cmd-V supports text clipboard paste, wraps bracketed-paste markers when enabled and translates newlines otherwise, but this source-only audit did not run it
send-text remains pane-targeted input rather than a shared CLI/native paste owner; paste/upload and remote transfer commands are absent
Missing --workspace/--surface/--window resolution, stdin, --submit, --force, encoded-size limit, draft/dialog guard, generation-bound delivery and pasted-but-submit-failed semantics
acceptance: Retain native bracketed-paste/newline behavior and route CLI and Cmd-V through one surface-identity paste owner
Sanitize controls with an explicit 15 MiB encoded limit and bind queued delivery to the originating surface generation
Refuse agent drafts/dialogs unless forced, and never retry after text was pasted but submit failed

features.feature: Agent session move between local and SSH endpoints
gaps: move-surface only reparents a live local tab
No endpoint parser, transport safety check, transcript/history/memory copy, working-directory map or code snapshot transfer
No refusal for live source/destination sessions, dirty/diverged destination or missing repository/worktree
acceptance: Move a supported stopped agent session local-to-SSH and SSH-to-local while preserving session identity
Carry the exact working tree and session artifacts with precondition checks
Leave source and destination recoverable after any refusal or interrupted transfer

features.feature: Portable session file save and open
gaps: No session save <path> or session open <path> commands and no portable snapshot file contract
Recently closed is process-local recovery, not an explicit export/import path
Missing absolute-path validation, no-scrollback export, live-snapshot destination refusal, import trust/pruning and stable identity/workspace collision exclusion
acceptance: Require a normalized absolute path and export a portable snapshot without scrollback while refusing the live persistence destination
Import only bounded regular snapshot data through the trust and crash-diagnostic pruning policies
Create bounded new windows while excluding live stable identities and workspace IDs, and do not take focus unless explicitly requested

features.feature: Typed agent launch, resume, composer and input ownership
gaps: Only generic local program/args/cwd launch exists
No agent kind, session ID, surface binding, managed wrapper, resume evidence, restore lease or provider-specific argv policy
No native TextBox composer owner for focus toggling, submit-action cycling, attachments, draft rollback or exact-surface input delivery
acceptance: Launch and resume supported agents with stable agent/session/surface identity
Reject unsafe or ambiguous launch capture and restore evidence while preserving working directory, account/profile and focus choice
Toggle composer/terminal focus only in the resolved panel, disable unsafe action cycling, preserve draft and attachments on failed submit, and clean temporary attachments only after admitted delivery

features.feature: Claude Teams and Codex Teams managed launchers
gaps: No claude-teams or codex-teams commands
Generic process launch does not validate a managed surface, create private tmux compatibility shims or export canonical agent launch identity
No Codex localhost app-server/watcher, bounded subagent depth, approval bridge or native split projection
acceptance: Resolve the required provider executable and preserve provider arguments while refusing a real launch outside a managed terminal
Bind the launcher, app-server, watcher and every projected teammate/subagent pane to canonical workspace/surface identity across moves
Clean up shims and local child processes and report missing executable, bad cwd, port allocation, readiness and exec failures distinctly

features.feature: OMO, OMX and OMC managed integration launchers
gaps: No omo, omx or omc commands
No provider executable/plugin discovery, loopback-port selection or private tmux compatibility routing
No managed-surface validation, canonical launch environment or provider-specific exec failure model
acceptance: Validate managed context before plugin installation or mutation and preserve all provider arguments
Create private compatibility shims and bind integration-created panes to the current canonical surface rather than stale inherited routing
Surface missing executable/plugin, invalid context, port/shim creation and exec failure and leave no partial install after precondition failure

features.feature: Durable agent-to-agent messages and replies
gaps: Notifications do not provide durable agent-directed delivery
Missing target/reply-to, --from, --thread, stdin body, sender surface/workspace identity and per-surface/workspace/global enablement
No queued/delivered/read/failed state or no-agent waiting behavior
acceptance: Resolve workspace title/id/ref or surface target and preserve sender, thread and reply identity
Persist and expose delivery state across target restart
Refuse disabled targets and fail already queued messages according to the setting contract

features.feature: Agent inbox claim, lease, acknowledgement and wake-up
gaps: The human notification inbox is not an agent inbox
Missing state/limit/mark-read filters, surface-scoped poller registration, supersession, deferred claim lease and ack
No feature-gated agent inbox shortcut/quick view, reply composer ownership, Claude wake or Codex stop/prompt-submit delivery semantics
acceptance: Deliver each message to one owning agent poller with lease/ack and supersession
Open the quick view in the resolved window, keep selection shortcuts out of a focused reply field, and submit each reply once to the exact target
Wake supported idle agents without editing a human draft; bound retries and fail open for disabled/headless/missing-surface hook contexts

features.feature: Agent lifecycle and provider hook processing
gaps: No hooks namespace or provider adapters
Missing install/uninstall/setup, payload limits/parsing, process/surface binding, spool/retry and event-specific status/notification mapping
No explicit fail-open versus fail-closed policy or user-visible failure reporting
acceptance: Install and remove supported hooks idempotently without overwriting unrelated user config
Bind events to the correct process/session/surface and dedupe replay
Expose malformed payload, stale binding and delivery failure while respecting each provider's required exit contract

features.feature: Agent hibernation policy and per-surface hibernate/wake
gaps: Closing a local PTY is not hibernation
Missing global on/off and resolved workspace/surface hibernate/wake commands
No checkpoint/readiness policy, resumable identity or wake failure state
acceptance: Hibernate only eligible idle agents and retain resumable session identity
Wake the exact target without selecting it unless focus was requested
Report unsupported, busy, checkpoint failure and missing-session outcomes distinctly

features.feature: AI account discovery and selection
gaps: zmux cloud user/device sign-in is unrelated to agent-provider accounts
No ai-accounts command, provider account discovery, active-account selection or restore account pin
No redacted output or missing/expired account failure model
acceptance: List provider accounts without exposing tokens or credential paths
Select/preserve the intended account for launch and resume
Handle missing, expired, ambiguous and unavailable provider state explicitly

features.feature: cmux-owned CodeRouter status, machine usage, accounts and agent control
gaps: No coderouter status, machines, claude or agent owned verbs
Cloud account state does not expose selected-team route status, 30-day per-machine token/cost usage or routed VM agent launch
No Claude OAuth/API-key/Bedrock add/list/remove/enable/disable/clear contract with masked output and safe secret intake
acceptance: Separate cmux-owned verbs from passthrough and route agent launch through one VM-agent owner
Read OAuth/API/AWS secrets only from environment, bounded stdin or hidden prompt, validate credential kinds and never print raw values
Expose team/auth/account and 30-day machine usage with explicit authorization, unavailable and partial-account failures

features.feature: CodeRouter CLI passthrough and interactive bootstrap
gaps: No cr alias or passthrough for unowned coderouter verbs
No bundled/PATH/install-directory executable resolution or interactive missing-tool bootstrap
No CMUX_*/CMUXD_* environment stripping, HTTPS/TLS installer download policy or child exit/signal preservation
acceptance: Forward every cr invocation and only unowned coderouter verbs without rewriting arguments
Strip cmux control-plane environment, resolve deterministically and make installation an explicit interactive choice with exit 127 for every unavailable path
Download only over HTTPS with TLS 1.2+, clean private temporary files, and preserve child exit or 128+signal status

features.feature: Registered external agent launcher matching and routing
gaps: Generic program launch has no launcher registry
Missing id/kind/kinds/detect/resume-prefix/includes-executable matching and forwarded executable scanning
No ambiguity/rejection or owner-preserving resume route
acceptance: Resolve a single registered launcher from explicit kind or argv detection
Reject ambiguous/empty/unsafe matches rather than broadening behavior
Route resume back through the launcher that owned the original session

features.feature: Agent/session checkpoint and restore evidence
gaps: Recently closed recreates local UI/session state and is not an agent checkpoint
No transcript/rollout/scrollback evidence, lease, provider checkpoint identity or verification limit
No stale/partial/ambiguous checkpoint failure model
acceptance: Capture bounded restore evidence tied to provider session and surface generation
Admit one restore owner through a lease and verify the resumed identity
Refuse stale, ambiguous or incomplete evidence without launching a new unrelated agent

features.feature: Agent session vault, provider indexes and recovery
gaps: No vault/recover namespace or persisted provider indexes
Missing list/search/show/recover semantics and provider-specific session existence checks
No corruption, inaccessible store, duplicate identity or partial recovery handling
acceptance: Index supported provider sessions with stable identity and redacted metadata
Search/show without launching and recover through the typed resume owner
Detect corruption, missing artifacts and duplicate sessions without mutating unrelated provider state

features.feature: Feed workstream TUI and persisted-history clearing
gaps: No feed tui or feed clear commands and no persisted agent workstream projection
No interactive OpenTUI/legacy selection, authenticated socket handoff, first-run bounded dependency preparation or foreground process-group restoration
The notification inbox has no Feed approval/question/reply state and no confirmation-gated history deletion
acceptance: Render bounded workstream, approval, question and completion state in an interactive terminal without selecting an app pane
Validate mutually exclusive TUI options, restore the caller process group and surface missing Bun/source/install/socket and child-exit failures
Clear only the owned Feed history after confirmation unless --yes/-y is explicit, and handle a missing store idempotently

features.feature: Bounded in-app notification lifecycle
gaps: zmux covers explicit title/body and list/read/open/dismiss/clear-through but not subtitle, reply shape, desktop override, all-read dismiss or cmux target selector forms
History is process-local and lacks cmux surface-move rebinding/persistence
No runtime/package verification was performed in this audit
acceptance: Retain current bounded/generation-safe tests
Add caller/window/workspace/surface targeting and selector validation without weakening stale-ack protection
Persist/rebind notification identity across supported surface moves and restore

features.feature: Attention signals, unread badges and exact-target focus acknowledgement
gaps: Bell/OSC/explicit signals, Dock badge and exact surface open/read are covered
No jump-to-unread/jump-to-last-prompt, moved-surface rebinding or multiwindow attention routing
Source tests do not establish installed-app focus/accessibility behavior
acceptance: Keep ordinary output distinct from attention and preserve exact generation targeting
Verify multiwindow open/jump and moved-surface routing without background focus theft
Run packaged-app focus, Dock badge and accessibility checks

features.feature: macOS notification delivery, permission, actions and replies
gaps: Inbox and Dock badge do not deliver an OS notification
No authorization state, native delivery policy, click/reply action, command hook or permission-denied fallback owner
No mapping back to exact window/workspace/surface generation
acceptance: Request and observe permission without blocking in-app notifications
Deliver allowed native notifications and route click/reply to the exact live target
Handle denied/revoked permission, closed/moved targets and stale actions visibly without focus theft

features.feature: Native notification click, reply and custom action routing
gaps: In-app open/read/dismiss buttons do not handle native notification responses
No reply-shape text response, native action identifier or command callback
No stale/moved/closed target resolution from an OS-delivered notification
acceptance: Route native click and reply to the exact notification and current surface owner
Mark read only after the requested action is admitted
Reject stale or unowned actions without activating an unrelated window, executing local content or losing the reply

features.feature: Surface/workspace status metadata
gaps: zmux status reports app/topology state, not agent/program sidebar status
No set-status, clear-status, list-status or target identity
No title/icon/color/state ownership, replacement or stale update policy
acceptance: Set/list/clear status on the intended surface/workspace without changing focus
Dedupe or replace by stable producer identity
Reject stale/unowned targets and bound user-provided metadata

features.feature: Explicit workspace pull-request metadata handoff
gaps: No pr <url|number> or pr clear command and no manual workspace PR metadata store
Missing explicit/caller-TTY/ambient/unique-worktree target resolution with ambiguity and window checks
No bounded gh repository/PR lookup, GitHub URL canonicalization, fork/upstream validation or injection-safe sidebar handoff
acceptance: Resolve one workspace without using mutable UI focus and reject ambiguous, remote or cross-window targets
Accept only a positive PR number or canonical HTTPS github.com pull URL belonging to the detected repository or allowed parent
Attach/replace or clear only the manual workspace link through one framed metadata mutation, preserving watcher refresh and reporting auth, timeout, malformed and mismatch failures

features.feature: Surface/workspace progress metadata
gaps: Running/unread status dots are not progress records
No set-progress/clear-progress target, value, label or owner
No validation, coalescing or terminal-completion cleanup
acceptance: Set and clear bounded labeled progress for an exact target without selecting it
Validate ranges and coalesce high-frequency reports off the UI thread
Clear or retain progress according to explicit lifecycle rules on exit/move/restore

features.feature: Bounded surface/workspace log metadata
gaps: Debug snapshot strings are not user/program logs
No append/list/clear target-scoped log channel
No size/count budget, ordering, redaction or ownership policy
acceptance: Append/list/clear logs on an exact target with deterministic order
Enforce entry and history budgets and expose dropped counts
Keep secrets and unowned local state out of remote relay responses

features.feature: Authenticated replayable event stream
gaps: No events command or stream method
Missing --after/--after-seq, --cursor-file, repeatable --name/--category, --reconnect, --limit, --timeout, --snapshot, --no-ack and --no-heartbeat options
No sequence/replay store, heartbeat, cursor atomicity, monotonic timeout or transient-only reconnect
acceptance: Stream ordered authenticated events with stable sequence and replay cursor
Filter names/categories without advancing past unseen matching events incorrectly
Reconnect only transient failures within the monotonic timeout and expose replay gaps/dropped events

features.feature: Caller-neutral Glaeda execution request and observation exchange
gaps: No glaeda request or observe offline command
Missing exact request/work refs, canonical repository, commit/tree and reuse-hint contract plus request/receipt correlation
No duplicate/unknown/missing option rejection or bounded no-follow regular-file/stdin reads
acceptance: Emit canonical JSON containing only caller-neutral refs, repository, commit, tree and reuse policy
Observe an exact request and bounded receipt, require terminal-result digest and reject correlation or schema mismatch
Reject duplicate/unknown/missing options, symlinks, nonregular and oversized inputs without workspace, machine, shell, environment or focus side effects

features.feature: Persisted event automation rules and action logs
gaps: No automation list/show/test/enable/disable/logs/reload namespace
No persisted rule matcher, redacted dry-run event/action payload or workspace-tag predicate
No bounded execution log, idempotency, permission or focus policy
acceptance: Load validated rules and expose list/show/enable/disable/reload
Use one matcher for offline dry-run and live execution
Log match/action/failure with redaction and idempotency; background actions must not steal focus

features.feature: Workspace todo and status workflow
gaps: Workspace names/topology have no todo model
No target-scoped list/add/update/complete/remove/status commands
No stable todo identity, persistence, ordering, validation or move/restore behavior
acceptance: Create, list, update, complete and remove todos against an exact workspace
Persist stable IDs/order/status across restore and workspace moves
Reject unowned/ambiguous targets and surface invalid transitions

features.feature: Generic integration hook setup and event translation
gaps: No hooks/setup-hooks/uninstall-hooks command
Missing --agent selection, provider config formats, idempotent merge/removal and event schema translation
No ownership marker, backup/recovery or partial-install reporting
acceptance: Install/update/remove only zmux-owned hook entries while preserving unrelated config
Validate every supported provider format and translate events to stable internal types
Report partial writes with a recoverable backup and make repeated setup/removal idempotent
